# braces stack-exhaustion DoS through deeply nested patterns. Every release up
# to 3.0.3 (the latest) is affected and there is no patched version. It only
# reaches us through build and test tooling (jest, ts-loader, tailwindcss via
# micromatch), which never expands untrusted patterns.
GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm

# tinypool prototype pollution gadgets reaching RCE through worker options.
# Fixed only in tinypool 2.1.2+, which needs Node 20+, while the Node.js SDK
# still supports and tests on Node 18 with vitest 3 (tinypool ^1). Test
# runner only; it never handles untrusted input.
GHSA-5gmw-xhrv-c9v3
GHSA-85c8-ppgw-ccpr

# decode-uri-component DoS in decoding, reached through minio > query-string@7.
# The fix (0.5.1) is ESM-only and query-string@7 loads it with require(), so
# forcing it breaks minio. minio only calls query-string's stringify, never
# parse, and nothing else in the api decodes with it. Revisit when minio moves
# to a query-string that takes the fixed decoder.
GHSA-qr28-fpjm-wq7f
CVE-2026-118664
